κατ-ευλογέω, -ῶ, 
[in LXX: Tob.11.1, 17 * ;] 
to bless fervently: Mrk.10.16 (see Swete, in l).†
(AS)

κατήγωρ, ὁ (Aram. קָטִיגוֺר; Dalman, Gr., 185; but see Deiss., LAE, 90 f.), 
= κατήγορος, 
an accuser: Rev.12.10.†
(AS)

1. to remove to a place, plant, settle or establish there as colonists , κ. τινὰ εἰς τόπον (Herdotus Historicus); γυναῖκας ἐς φῶς ἡλίου κατ. (Euripides):—;also, κ. τινὰ ἐν τόπῳ to settle or plant one in , (Sophocles Tragicus); ἐλπίδας ἔν τινι κ. to plant them in his mind, (Aeschulus Tragicus) 
2. with accusative loci, to colonise, people a place, (Herdotus Historicus), etc. 
3. Pass., 
4. of persons, to be placed or…

κατωτέρω, see: κάτω.
κάτω 
adv. (κατά), [in LXX for מַטָּה, תַּחַת and cogn. forms ;] 
__1. down, downwards (with verbs of motion), Mat.4.6, Luk.4.9, Jhn.8.6, 8, Act.20.9. 
__2. below, beneath: Mrk.14.66, Act.2.19" (LXX) ; ἕως κ. (Ezk.1.27, al.), Mat.27.51, Mrk.15.38. τὰ κ. (opposite to τ. ἄνω), Jhn.8.23. Compar. κατωτέρω: ἀπὸ διετοῦς καὶ κ. (cf. 1Ch.27.21), Mat.2.16.†
(AS)

κλινάριον, -ου, τό, 
dimin, of κλίνη, 
a couch: Act.5.15 (cf. κλινίδιον).†
(AS)

κυκλεύω 
(κύκλος), [in LXX: 2Ki.3.25 B (סָבַב) * ;] 
__1. to make a circle, go round. 
__2. to encircle, surround: with accusative of person(s), Jhn.10.24 (Tr., WH, mg.); with accusative of thing(s), Rev.20.9.†
(AS)
